bandReport.notes: Layout: p18 (printed 37) left column Q97-Q100, right column Q101-Q102; p19 (printed 39) left column Q103-Q105, right column Q106-Q108. Q97 begins at the top of p18 with its number and a complete stem, so nothing from the previous band spills onto my first page. Q102 ends with all four options complete at the foot of p18's right column and does not continue overleaf; Q108 ends with all four options well clear of the footer on p19, so nothing spills into the next band. The OCR reading-order artifact flagged in my brief was confirmed and resolved from the page: on p19 the text layer interleaves Q105's (c)/(d) with Q108's (b)/(c)/(d), because at the foot of that page the two columns sit at the same height. I re-cropped that zone at 4x and assigned every option by COLUMN, not by height: Q105 (left) = convergence of investment / expand cultivable area / on-farm water use efficiency / protect farmers against crop failure; Q108 (right) = Iran / Sri Lanka / Japan / Pakistan. Note the PDF holds only the English pages - printed page numbers run 37 then 39 (page 38 is the Hindi version, visible on p19 only as show-through from the reverse) - so my two pages are contiguous in the question sequence and 97-108 has no gap. Nothing visible on either page belongs to a neighbouring band.
